_readme: Card benefits by card product. Edit amounts here when an issuer changes terms, bump checkedOn, then push. matchAny: words to look for in a transaction on that card (a statement credit line or a qualifying purchase) to detect a use. period: monthly | semiannual (Jan-Jun / Jul-Dec) | yearly (calendar year) | cardYear (resets on the card's anniversary, from its annual-fee charge; calendar year until one is found) | every4Years.
